mapper.select: SELECT a.metadata_field_id AS metadataFieldId, mf.field_name AS fieldName, mf.field_code AS fieldCode, mf.biz_type AS bizType, a.operator AS operator, a.attr_value AS attrValue FROM tab_user_role_rule_user_attr a INNER JOIN tab_metadata_field mf ON mf.id = a.metadata_field_id WHERE a.rule_id = #{ruleId} ORDER BY a.id ASC
